chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a tall muscular young man wearing a white tank top, red basketball shorts and white slides.
chars.YAHYA: YAHYA: a short stocky young man wearing an oversized mustard-yellow t-shirt, grey sweatpants and black flip-flops.
chars.BOSS: BOSS: a huge broad-shouldered man, twice the size of the others, wearing a shiny black suit with an open purple shirt, a thick gold chain and dark sunglasses.
chars.GUARDS: GUARDS: four big men all dressed identically in plain black t-shirts, black trousers and black caps.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the messy living room of a rented villa in a hot West African city. YOUSSEF lies asleep sprawled on a sofa and YAHYA sleeps on the floor on a cushion, exhausted after a party; empty bottles and plates on a low table, warm sunlight through tall windows with palm trees outside.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same villa living room. Loud knocking at the wooden front door in the background: YAHYA sits up suddenly on the floor, startled, and YOUSSEF lifts his head from the sofa, both staring toward the door, worried.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside the villa front door in bright sunshine, seen through a peephole-like view: BOSS stands in front of the door with an intimidating posture, and the four GUARDS stand behind him in a row, arms crossed. Sandy courtyard, a parked black SUV behind them.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the villa near the front door: YOUSSEF and YAHYA press their backs against the wall next to the closed door, terrified, hands on their heads, panicking.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the villa: YOUSSEF and YAHYA crouch behind a curtain at the window, peeking outside nervously and whispering to each other, YOUSSEF pointing toward the back door as if suggesting to run.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YAHYA slowly opens the front door just a little, nervous, looking up at BOSS who stands huge in the doorway, sunlight behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door: BOSS calmly gestures with an open hand asking to come inside, YAHYA turns his head back to look at YOUSSEF behind him in the hallway, YOUSSEF hesitantly nods.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: BOSS steps alone into the villa living room while the four GUARDS stay outside the door in the background; YOUSSEF and YAHYA step back nervously to let him in.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the villa living room BOSS sits relaxed in an armchair, leaning forward, pointing a finger at YOUSSEF and YAHYA who sit stiffly side by side on the sofa facing him, sweating and frozen with fear.
